title: Progressive Delivery -- deployment strategy comparison
description: Milestone 6: template-test-1 runs three deployment strategies in parallel on dev, each its own namespace (template-test-1-{rolling,bluegreen,canary}) -- every panel here is split by namespace so the three are directly comparable side by side. Drive a live comparison with scripts/simulate-bad-rollout.sh.

panels.title: Success rate (2xx) by variant
panels.description: The core comparison: run scripts/simulate-bad-rollout.sh to push a synthetic fault to all three at once and watch these lines diverge -- rolling drops and stays down (no protection), canary drops then recovers on its own (automated rollback), blue-green's active line should never move at all (bad build stays parked in preview).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace=~"template-test-1-.*", path="/", status=~"2.."}[1m])) / sum by (namespace) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace=~"template-test-1-.*", path="/"}[1m]))

panels.title: Canary traffic split (measured) -- stable vs. canary pod
panels.description: Only meaningful in template-test-1-canary while a rollout is in progress: real, observed request share per ReplicaSet (rollouts-pod-template-hash), not just the configured setWeight -- confirms Istio is actually routing the split, not merely that the Rollout object says it should be.

targets.expr: sum by (rollouts_pod_template_hash) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="template-test-1-canary", path="/"}[1m])) / ignoring(rollouts_pod_template_hash) group_left sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="template-test-1-canary", path="/"}[1m]))

panels.title: Rollout status by variant
panels.description: Current phase per Rollout (rolling has no Rollout object -- it's a plain Deployment, not shown here). Progressing/Paused = mid-rollout; Completed = steady state; Degraded/Error/Abort = something failed and the controller reacted.

panels.title: Updated / desired replicas by variant
panels.description: Pod-health proxy for the two Rollout-managed variants: Updated < Desired means the new ReplicaSet hasn't finished rolling out yet.

panels.title: Synthetic probe success by variant
panels.description: Blackbox's independent, outside-in confirmation of the same story -- doesn't rely on the app's own metrics pipeline at all.
